verdict.rationale: Postmark documents open tracking per server and per email with a Message Opens API, link (click) tracking, and a Stats API for delivery, open and click statistics. Its Messages API lets you search and retrieve message details, which answers 'what happened to this email?' The evidence is mostly section titles, though, so the depth of the per-message event timeline is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a per-message event history or timeline (delivery, open, click events per MessageID), an explicitly named per-message clicks query API, and independent hands-on corroboration.
